answer.IBCDR: healthy-base controls for normative model; healthy-ICA controls for ICA guidance; FEDN-MDD patients for deviation/clustering

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: IBCDR provided 91 FEDN-MDD patients and matched healthy controls; a healthy-base group for patients; an independent healthy-ICA group to create group-level components as guidance information in ICA.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "This study included data from 91 FEDN patients and 91 matched healthy individuals obtained from the International Big-Data Center for Depression Research."; "we used the matchIt function in R ... to select the comparable group from the healthy controls as the healthy-base group for the patients"; "Another independent sample (125 control individuals, 71 females) from the other two centers ... was a healthy-ICA group to create the group-level components as guidance information in ICA."
